scene_description: A small area with two structures: a cobblestone shelter (5x5x4 hollow) containing a redstone block at floor level, and a smaller oak planks hut as a distractor. A stone brick path from spawn leads toward the cobblestone structure. The redstone block is visible through a 2x2 doorway in the structure's south-facing wall. Corner fence posts mark scene boundaries.
task_text: Find the redstone block. Navigate the area and locate the bright red redstone block hidden inside one of the structures.
design_notes: Redstone block at relative (~6, ~1, ~6) inside cobblestone structure (~4,~0,~4 to ~8,~3,~8). Doorway on south wall at (~4-5, ~1-2, ~4) gives clear line of sight. Player spawns at ~0,~0,~0 on stone brick path facing the structure direction. Distance from spawn to redstone block is ~8.5 blocks diagonal. Oak planks hut at (~-5 to ~-3) serves as distractor. Task requires walking forward-right ~6-8 blocks and looking through or entering the doorway.
